meta.title: Evomon capture balls data
meta.imageAcceptedMissingReason: No clean, reusable per-ball icon exists from a reliable source. Evomon's wiki.gg Items page lists food/tools/fusion items but no capture balls; there is no Capture Balls page (404). The Fandom guide wiki returns 403. Reliable guide sites (Sportskeeda, Pro Game Guides, AllThings.How) only carry article thumbnails and in-game screenshots, not isolated ball icons, which the image rules disallow. The only source with ball-specific art is evomon-world.wiki, already flagged as unreliable. Per parent guidance, accepted text-first for this 4-item ball list rather than using logos, screenshots, or unrelated images. Matches the sibling Evomon islands collection, which also accepted text-first.

sources.label: Sportskeeda - How to get Prismatic Balls in Evomon
sources.note: Prismatic Ball: 100% catch rate, guaranteed SSS talent + random sparkling effect, 799 Robux each or 7,990 for a pack of 10, also from the Season Battle Pass. Notes Advanced and King as lesser alternatives.

sources.label: Sportskeeda - Evomon Season Battle Pass guide
sources.note: King Ball 'Guarantees that the captured evomon will have the SSS talent.' Prismatic Ball guarantees SSS talent plus a sparkling appearance. King Balls at pass levels 10/20/40; Prismatic at 25 and 50.

sources.label: Pro Game Guides - Complete Evomon Farming Guide
sources.note: Advanced = Coin Shop; King = weekly Daily Quests + Battle Pass; Prismatic = Battle Pass completion. Balls also drop from codes, map chests, NPC quests, and the Traveling Merchant.

sources.label: AllThings.How - Evomon Farming Guide
sources.note: Basic Ball is the default starter; Advanced is bought for Coins in the Coin Shop; higher rarities (Advanced, King, Prismatic) give the catch rates needed for rare monsters.

sources.label: Beebom - Evomon Codes
sources.note: Confirms Advanced Ball as a common code reward (e.g. 10x, 5x), the main code-farmable ball.

meta.notes: Four confirmed in-game capture balls (Basic, Advanced, King, Prismatic). SSS Ball and Diamond Ball were excluded because they appear only on evomon-world.wiki and are contradicted by every reliable source. Exact catch-rate percentages are not officially published except for the Prismatic Ball (100%), so the other balls use qualitative tiers. All four balls share one section ('Capture Balls') so the list renders as a single clean power-tier ladder (Basic to Prismatic) rather than four one-card section headers. The checker emits only a single-section WARN, matching the sibling islands collection precedent.

items.name: Basic Ball
items.howToGet: Default ball every player has in unlimited supply
items.bestUse: Catching common, low-rarity Evomon while you build up coins and better balls.
items.cardSummary: The free starter ball every player carries without limit. It has a standard catch rate and no talent or rarity bonus, so it is meant for early common catches rather than rare targets.
items.sourceStatus: Confirmed across AllThings.How and Pro Game Guides farming guides
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local ball icon collected yet

items.name: Advanced Ball
items.effect: Stronger catch chance, no talent bonus
items.howToGet: Buy with Coins in the Coin Shop, or claim from codes
items.bestUse: General farming and improving your odds on rarer Evomon when premium balls are scarce.
items.cardSummary: A purchasable upgrade over the Basic Ball with a stronger catch chance but no talent guarantee. It is the main code-reward ball and the workhorse for everyday catching of rarer Evomon.
items.sourceStatus: Confirmed across Pro Game Guides, AllThings.How, and Beebom codes
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local ball icon collected yet

items.name: King Ball
items.effect: Guarantees SSS talent on the catch
items.howToGet: Weekly Daily Quest reward and Season Battle Pass levels (4-5 from the free track)
items.bestUse: Securing an SSS-talent catch on bosses and rare spawns when you do not need the sparkling effect.
items.cardSummary: A premium ball that guarantees the captured Evomon has the top SSS talent. Earned from weekly Daily Quests and the Battle Pass, it is the go-to for locking in SSS talent on tough or rare targets.
items.sourceStatus: Effect confirmed by Sportskeeda Battle Pass guide; acquisition by Pro Game Guides
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local ball icon collected yet

items.name: Prismatic Ball
items.effect: Guarantees the catch, SSS talent, and a random sparkling effect
items.howToGet: Season Battle Pass levels (1 from completion) or buy for 799 Robux each (pack of 10 for 7,990 Robux)
items.bestUse: Endgame captures of the strongest or rarest Evomon when you want a guaranteed SSS, sparkling catch.
items.cardSummary: The top-tier ball with a guaranteed 100% catch, a guaranteed SSS talent, and a random sparkling effect. It is the premium choice for the strongest Evomon, earned from the Battle Pass or bought with Robux.
items.sourceStatus: Confirmed across Sportskeeda (two guides) and Pro Game Guides
